verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.highnote.com/llms.txt, with a structured Highnote Documentation header and summary. Highnote also serves markdown versions of marketing pages (e.g. agentic-commerce.md), which gives agents clean, machine-readable content. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant, first-party docs describing the agent-oriented docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use it effectively.
